summary: Modules must run commands through AnsibleModule.run_command, which tests mock with patch.object to set a return value and assert how it was called.
questions: How do I mock run_command in a module test?
How do I check which command my module ran?

answer_card.title: Mock run_command
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
    run_command.return_value = 0, '', ''   # rc, stdout, stderr
    with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
        my_module.main()
run_command.assert_called_once_with('/usr/bin/command args')
```
